mapper.sql:
FROM member_task_completion c LEFT JOIN member_task_reward_grant g ON g.completion_id = c.completion_id AND g.company_id = c.company_id WHERE c.company_id = #{companyId} AND c.task_id = #{taskId} AND c.voided = 0
AND g.status = 'granted'
AND g.status = 'failed'
mapper.select:
SELECT c.completion_id AS completion_id, c.user_id AS user_id, c.completed_at AS completed_at, g.grant_id AS grant_id, g.status AS grant_status, g.error_message AS error_message
ORDER BY c.completion_id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
